[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Velantia''' was a member of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] who had a prosthetic jewel right [[Eye/Legends|eye]] which was fitted with a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he received information from the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], [[Tresk]], which had been stolen from an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] cell on [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]].
